title: Multiply a value
summary: Assembly: Multiply a value. Multiply by 3.
introduction: imul multiplies signed integers. This form stores the result in its first register.

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Multiply a value
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 3
    imul rdi, rdi, 2
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: imul multiplies the value 3 by 2 and stores 6 in rdi.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Large results can overflow a register.
